timothy1.2.p1.b1.text: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—

timothy1.2.p1.b2.text: for kings and all those in authority

timothy1.2.p1.b3.text: so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.

timothy1.2.p1.b4.text: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

timothy1.2.p2.b1.text: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men,

timothy1.2.p2.b2.text: who gave Himself as a ransom for all

timothy1.2.p2.b3.text: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles.

timothy1.2.p2.b4.text: I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.

timothy1.2.p3.b1.text: Therefore I want the men … without anger or dissension.

timothy1.2.p3.b2.text: everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands,

timothy1.2.p3.b3.text: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, …

timothy1.2.p3.b4.text: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.

timothy1.2.p4.b1.text: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.

timothy1.2.p4.b2.text: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.

timothy1.2.p4.b3.text: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.

timothy1.2.p4.b4.text: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
